collection: Phishing Email Curated Datasets, Zenodo 8339691, v1
attribution: Champa, Rabbi and Zibran (2024), Curated datasets and feature analysis for phishing email detection with machine learning; Why phishing emails escape detection: A closer look at the failure points. DOI:10.5281/zenodo.8339691
usage_notes: Publisher marks the collection CC BY 4.0. Attribute the collection and underlying corpora. Local research text only; raw/derived message text and learned artifacts are not redistributed in Git. Publicly released corpus text only; no private workspace emails or payloads. Spam labels in Ling/SpamAssassin are excluded rather than relabeled as phishing. Fraud emails are included in the social-engineering/phishing class, which is broader than credential theft.
promotion_limitations: Each admitted original corpus supplies one class, so source and label are confounded even after metadata removal.
Historical English-centric public corpora do not validate contemporary inbox false-positive rates or BEC coverage.
Independent modern, source-balanced phishing labels are required before default activation.
